items.headline: Hovland Withdraws in 2026
items.text: Viktor Hovland recorded his first withdrawal of 2026 following a missed cut at the PGA Championship, marking another setback in his turbulent season.

items.headline: LIV Criticism on Majors Prep
items.text: Critics argue that LIV Golf's format leaves players like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm less prepared for major championships.
